notes: The drawing depicts an assembly: one steel plate and two separate sponge-rubber strips. Planned executable features produce the steel plate; unsupported strip features document exact nominal assembly geometry without merging dissimilar materials.

X runs left to right and Y bottom to top in the broad-face view. Positive Z runs from the visible steel face toward the underside and rubber strips; the complete assembly envelope minimum is the origin.
The four-hole callout is applied to the steel plate only. No piercing of the rubber is specified clearly enough to model; confirm rubber preparation before assembly manufacture.
D014 is purchased total strip length, equal to two D011 lengths, not an additional geometric extent. Nominal stock thickness D010 agrees with BOM D021.
